design_condition: The long volume forms a clear transition from the city to the outdoor pool and closes the peninsula, with the entrance placed at the narrowing between canal and building.

positive.statement: The building establishes a clear transition from the city to the outdoor pool and precisely closes the peninsula.

position.target: transition from city to outdoor pool
position.rationale: Long continuous volume is visible; approximate lower-side placement represents urban-to-pool transition.

positive.statement: The main entrance is clearly positioned with short routes from the city and parking area.

position.rationale: Small localized feature near the lower narrowing plausibly indicates the entrance approach.

positive.statement: The main functional areas are arranged in a comprehensible and clear manner.

position.rationale: Central portion of the continuous volume anchors the broadly described internal functional arrangement.

positive.statement: The proposed phasing promises uninterrupted operation of the outdoor and indoor pools.

position.target: uninterrupted outdoor and indoor pool operation
position.rationale: Operational phasing is a performance judgment without a useful geometric location.

positive.statement: The project has a small cubage and promises an economical solution.

position.rationale: Distributed placement on the elongated envelope represents the overall cubage assessment.

negative.statement: The barn image was controversially discussed as either backward-looking nostalgia or the dawn of a sustainable future.

position.rationale: The elongated barn-like volume is clearly identifiable across top and elevation views.

negative.statement: A shell fully glazed on all sides raises questions because of the risk of glare.

position.rationale: East envelope surface anchors the all-sides glazing concern on the visible continuous shell.

negative.statement: The structural logic is not sufficiently conveyed; the roof structure appears fragmented and schematic.

position.rationale: Roof-line geometry is visible, though its fragmented support logic is not separately distinguishable.

negative.statement: The roof support construction fragments the impression of space.

position.rationale: Upper envelope placement represents the roof supports implicated in spatial fragmentation.

negative.statement: The open-space and planting concept remains schematic and not particularly sensual.

position.rationale: Adjacent ground region outside the building anchors the schematic landscape assessment.

negative.statement: The sunken open-topped bicycle yard appears strange, while bicycle parking is too far from the main entrance.

position.rationale: Lower-side external area provides a constrained surface estimate for the bicycle yard and access issue.

negative.statement: There is very limited space when accessing the outdoor pool.

position.rationale: External ground adjacent to the elongated volume anchors the constrained pool-access concern.

negative.statement: The project contains heated rooms outside the insulation perimeter, reduced room height in the later wellness area, and undersized technical rooms.

position.rationale: Central envelope location approximates the unshown internal rooms and wellness-area deficiencies.

negative.statement: The promised sustainable supporting structure is hardly credible at the slimness shown.

position.rationale: Roof-level placement anchors the supporting-structure credibility concern on the sampled envelope.
